messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx and 429s observed across gateway (us-west1, eu-central). error-rate 5xx > 8% for 3m, 429s increasing. affected route: /v1/generate (customer-facing). sample metric links: https://grafana/redwood/d/err-spike
Alice K: I’m paged. Taking lead. what’s the scope? any customer-reported tickets?
Raj Patel: Seeing a big uptick in 429s from quota-service -> upstream model-proxy. Traces show quota check latency spiking and then gateway returning 429, downstream timeouts follow.
Maria Torres: Confirmed. Top trace: quota-service latency jumped from 20ms to 800ms, requests backlog grows -> model-proxy starts returning 504s.
Dave Chen: Hypothesis: recent quota roll (auto-apply) changed `global_quota_enforce` to true + very low default. This could cause synchronous checks to block.
Alice K: Paging @pagerduty and @Support Lead to notify high customer impact. Marking as P1.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-01. Pager duty notified.
Support Lead: Noted. I’ll notify CS for customers with active SLAs.
Raj Patel: Repro steps from traces:
```
GET /v1/generate -> quota-check (sync) -> quota-service (timeout) -> 429
```
We should disable sync quota enforcement as a quick mitigation.
Maria Torres: Agreed. Can we flip to permissive mode (`quota.enforce=false`) while we debug?
Dave Chen: I can flip it. Plan: 1) set `quota.enforce=false` globally 2) increase quota cache TTL 3) enable fallback routing to smaller model-variant to reduce backend load.
Alice K: Do the flip and push a canary rollback. Announce here when done.
Deploy-bot: Rollout requested by Dave Chen: feature-flag `quota.enforce=false` -> targeting service=quota-service, env=prod, rollout=canary
Dave Chen: rolled out to 10% of quota-service replicas now.
Alice K: Metrics watch on stage.
Maria Torres: 10% flip looks good, 5xx down a bit but 429 still high. move to 100%?
Dave Chen: Increasing to 100% now.
Deploy-bot: Rollout completed: `quota.enforce=false` at 100% for quota-service
Raj Patel: After disable: 429 rate dropped ~70% over 2m, 5xx dropped to baseline in us-west1 but eu-central still lagging. Investigating region config.
Alice K: Next mitigation: enable `grace_tokens` and bypass global ratecalc for heavy tenants. Maria can you apply tenant bypass for top 5 customers?
Maria Torres: Applying tenant bypass for top 5 now. CLI:
```
redwoodctl quota patch --tenant tenant-123 --bypass=true
```
Maria Torres: Done for all five. Confirming reduced errors for those tenants.
Support Lead: Sent templated message to impacted customers: "We are mitigating an infrastructure-level issue affecting request errors. We’ll provide updates every 30 minutes." (link to status page)
Raj Patel: Root cause: a mis-merged config in infra repo set `default_quota=10` requests/sec for all new customers and enabled `sync_enforce=true` last deploy. This caused a surge of quota-check RPCs as cache misses occurred.
Alice K: Good find. Next: revert mis-merge and add metric alert for quota-service latency > 200ms
Dave Chen: Reverted config, new PR: https://git.redwood/rev/12345 - going to patch and restart quota-service pods gracefully.
Deploy-bot: New deploy by Dave Chen: config-revert -> quota-service (prod)
Dave Chen: restart initiated: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/quota-service -n prod`
Maria Torres: Restart done. Pods healthy.
Raj Patel: Post-restart: latency back to ~25ms, 429s and 5xx down to normal. Gateway error rate now < 0.5%.
Alice K: Good. Can we validate no residual backlog? check queue depth and latency for model-proxy.
Dave Chen: queue depth normal, model-proxy latency back to baseline. Running additional load tests to ensure stability.
Support Lead: CS updated customers with rollback notice and ETA for postmortem.
Alice K: Assigning postmortem: Raj + Maria + Dave. Severity: SEV1, cause: quota config mis-merge + sync enforcement. Action items:
- Add guard in CI for `quota.enforce` toggles (Raj)
- Add cache-warmup on deploy (Maria)
- Rate-limit safe defaults + feature-flag gating (Dave)
pagerduty: Incident INC-20260315-01 acknowledged by Alice K. Follow-up tasks created.
Alice K: Closing the immediate paging loop. We’ll keep channel open for postmortem notes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260315-01 marked resolved by Alice K at 2026-03-15T14:45:12Z"
